BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The source object can come from request data such as parsed JSON.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: The polluted property must reach a code path that uses it.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: No account is needed to send the object.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: The impact stays within the vulnerable application.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: Changed application logic may expose limited data.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: Polluting Object.prototype changes the behaviour of the whole application.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: Polluted properties can crash request handling.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by static analysis of the vulnerable code pattern.
